scope: Operational definition only. This document resolves scalar, aggregation, ordering and tie semantics already required by v1.2; it does not add or remove an architecture, seed, metric family or selection stage.
outcome_use_in_this_operationalization: No new v1.2 continuation-state scientific output was used to choose these definitions.

metric_precision.predictive_and_class_f1: quantize decimal values to 8 places using ROUND_HALF_EVEN for selector comparisons
metric_precision.corruption_degradation_percentage_points: quantize to 8 decimal places using ROUND_HALF_EVEN for selector comparisons
metric_precision.reporting: retain higher/raw computational precision in evidence alongside selector-precision values

pareto_dimensions_exact.name: clean_predictive_quality
pareto_dimensions_exact.definition: Arithmetic mean of selected-checkpoint DS-V1-VAL macro-F1 over exactly S1,S2,S3 for the architecture.

pareto_dimensions_exact.name: worst_seed_reliability
pareto_dimensions_exact.definition: Minimum selected-checkpoint DS-V1-VAL macro-F1 over exactly S1,S2,S3 for the architecture.

pareto_dimensions_exact.name: class_tail_reliability
pareto_dimensions_exact.definition: For each of the 120 class indices, first compute the arithmetic mean class-F1 over S1,S2,S3. Sort the 120 class means ascending by (mean_f1, class_index); take the first 12; report the arithmetic mean of those 12 class means. The 12-class set is therefore architecture-specific but deterministically defined without manual class selection.

pareto_dimensions_exact.name: corruption_robustness
pareto_dimensions_exact.definition: For each direct state, compute clean validation macro-F1 minus corrupted macro-F1 in percentage points for every one of the fixed 5 corruptions x 3 severities, average the 15 deltas, then arithmetic-mean that state-level quantity over S1,S2,S3. Negative deltas, if any, are retained rather than clipped.

pareto_dimensions_exact.name: efficiency
pareto_dimensions_exact.definition: Architecture-level deterministic model-state footprint: for each state_dict tensor, floating tensors count numel*4 bytes (FP32 canonical footprint); non-floating buffers count numel*their actual element_size; sum over model state only, excluding optimizer, scheduler, checkpoint metadata and serialization-container overhead. This value must be identical across seeds or the architecture fails the efficiency-identity check.

pareto_rule.dominance: Architecture A dominates B iff A is no worse than B on every one of the five exact selector-precision scalars in the declared direction and strictly better on at least one.
pareto_rule.single_nondominated: If exactly one candidate is non-dominated, select it as journal-primary.
pareto_rule.multiple_nondominated: Apply the frozen lexicographic rule below only to the non-dominated set.

lexicographic_rule_exact.definition: Exact sum of numel over model.parameters(), independent of requires_grad state.

exact_tie.definition: A tie persists only when every frozen lexicographic criterion is equal at selector precision (metric criteria) or exactly equal (integer criteria).
exact_tie.action: Report co-primary scientific candidates and invoke only the separately frozen deployment-feasibility tie gate already authorized by v1.2. No additional Track-A experiment, model, seed, corruption, XAI method or post-result weighting is allowed.

supporting_reported_not_selector_dimensi: minimum class-F1 and its deterministic class index
theoretical MACs/FLOPs if one audited profiler supports every architecture
missing_or_failed_state_policy: A family is eligible only if all three intended direct states complete, unless the existing v1.2 transparent irrecoverable-technical-failure rule is invoked. Any such exception must be reported before model selection and may not be converted into a favorable missing-data rule.
forbidden: changing a selector scalar after seeing continuation-state outputs
using XAI visual appeal as a selector
clipping favorable or unfavorable corruption deltas
